events.name: The Spear and the Pearl: Lake 1
events.intro:
Three lakes light up in sequence, one after another, across the region.

At the first lake, Uxie, eyes closed, a subtitle: I will ask you a question. If you lie, you will forget your answer.
Uxie: What is the one thing your team cannot do?

branches.text: Uxie: "True." It closes its eyes again. The first lake goes still.

success.text: Uxie opens its eyes. You lied, and it knows. Your team forgets the weakness instead: something about a move goes vague.

branches.text: Uxie: "True." It closes its eyes again. The first lake goes still.

success.text: Uxie opens its eyes. You lied, and it knows. Your team forgets the weakness instead: something about a move goes vague.

branches.text: Uxie: "True." It closes its eyes again. The first lake goes still.

success.text: Uxie opens its eyes. You lied, and it knows. Your team forgets the weakness instead: something about a move goes vague.
The lake stays lit behind you.

events.name: The Spear and the Pearl: Lake 2
events.intro:
The second lake. Mesprit floats over the water.

Mesprit: If one of them had to stay here with me, who would you leave?
Every Pokémon in your party turns to look at you.

success.text: Mesprit laughs, delighted, and lets you all go.
Mesprit: "Good. You know." Your starter looks at you for a long time.
Mesprit: "Good. You know." The newest one looks at its feet.
Mesprit: "Good. You know." Your strongest looks away.

events.name: The Spear and the Pearl: Lake 3
events.intro:
The third lake. Azelf, already in the air above you.

Azelf: Lose to me. Then get up.

success.text: It is far stronger than you. That is the point.

events.name: The Spear and the Pearl: Get Up
events.intro: You are on the ground. Azelf waits.

success.text: Azelf: "Good." It gives you the last link of the Red Chain.
You limp away. The third lake goes dark.

events.name: The Spear and the Pearl: Spear Pillar

remembers.notice: Dialga knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Dialga.

success.text: Dialga lowers its head. Time goes very slow, and kind, and it comes with you.

remembers.notice: Palkia knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Palkia.

success.text: Palkia folds the space between you to nothing, and is beside you, and stays.

events.intro: Spear Pillar. The Red Chain glows; two crests burn in the sky.

success.text: Dialga comes, and the seconds bend around it.
Palkia comes, and the pillar seems very far away.
They fight each other, and you are in between. Survive eight turns.

win.text: Giratina's shadow crossed Spear Pillar, and both Keepers retreated.

events.name: Truth and Ideals
events.intro:
A dark stone, in a field, speaks as you walk past with two things on your team that hate each other.

The stone: "You carry two things that hate each other. How?"

success.text: The stone is silent a long time. Then it gives you a road to a divided town.
The stone hums. It gives you a road to a divided town.
The stone: "Good. Find out." A road opens to a divided town.

events.name: Truth and Ideals: The Divided Town
events.intro:
Half white, half black; a line painted down the street.

N, in the square: "I ask everyone the same thing. Which side of the line do you live on?"
N: "Nobody has said 'both' yet."

success.text: N nods, a little sadly.
N nods, a little sadly.
N looks up, and smiles, for the first time. "Then I will come and watch."

events.name: Truth and Ideals: Dragonspiral Tower

remembers.notice: N has followed you to the tower. He will watch.
Reshiram knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Reshiram.

success.text: Reshiram comes down and does not fight. It already knows what you believe.

remembers.notice: Zekrom knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Zekrom.

success.text: Zekrom comes down and does not fight. It already knows what you believe.

events.intro:
Two stones in your bag, both warm.

N: "It will ask what you believe. Not what's true. What you believe."

success.text: The light stone burns white. Reshiram descends.
The dark stone burns black. Zekrom descends.
Both stones crack. Both dragons appear for one turn, look at your Pokémon, and leave. Far away, something cold turns over in its sleep.

events.name: Life and Destruction
events.intro:
The forests are going grey from the edges in. At the bottom of a valley, a black cocoon throbs. On the far ridge, a dead tree has one green leaf.

A Lysandre Labs scientist, setting up instruments: "You're not supposed to be here. This is the most important energy source in the world."
Scientist: "It's asleep. When it wakes up, everything near it dies. We'd like to be the ones who decide what 'near' means."

success.text: You put your hand on the dead tree. It wakes. The forests heal from the ridge down. At the same moment, the cocoon hatches, furious.
The lab crew turns on you.

choices.label: Find out what the green lights are.

success.text: Zygarde's Cells assemble out of the grass. Zygarde decides, and the other two go back to sleep.

events.name: Life and Destruction: Both Awake

remembers.notice: Xerneas knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Xerneas.

success.text: Xerneas comes down off the ridge and stands beside you. It offers itself.

remembers.notice: Yveltal knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Yveltal.

success.text: Yveltal lands. It does not strike. It offers itself.

events.intro: Xerneas on the ridge, Yveltal over the valley. Yveltal strikes first.

success.text: Life and destruction, both at once.

events.name: Life and Destruction: Unwatched

remembers.notice: Yveltal knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Yveltal.

success.text: Yveltal lands. It does not strike. It offers itself.

events.intro: With nobody watching, the cocoon hatches at night. Yveltal strikes first.

success.text: The grey comes down the valley with it.

events.name: Life and Destruction: The Green Lights

remembers.notice: Zygarde knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Zygarde.

success.text: Zygarde coils at your feet. It has decided. It offers itself.

events.intro: Zygarde stands in the valley, made of a thousand green lights. It has decided.

success.text: It wants to see whether you are part of the balance.

events.name: The Sun and Moon Altars
events.intro:
A girl in a white hat runs past with a bag that is glowing. Two people in white coats run after her.

Lillie, stopping, out of breath: "Please. Please don't tell them which way I went."
The bag wriggles. A small star-shaped face pokes out.
Lillie: "Nebby, get back in the bag!"

success.text: Two Aether staff come round the corner.
Lillie: "My mother's people." She runs. You follow.
She hesitates. Nebby teleports into your arms anyway, and giggles.

events.name: The Sun and Moon Altars: Aether, Again
events.intro: Two people in white coats, again. Lillie holds the bag tight.

success.text: Aether staff.
You pull Lillie into an alley. They run past.
Pew. You are all somewhere else, a node away.

events.name: The Sun and Moon Altars: Aether, Again
events.intro: Two people in white coats, again. Lillie holds the bag tight.

success.text: Aether staff.
You pull Lillie into an alley. They run past.
Pew. You are all somewhere else, a node away.

events.name: The Sun and Moon Altars: Aether, Again
events.intro: Two people in white coats, again. Lillie holds the bag tight.

success.text: Aether staff.
You pull Lillie into an alley. They run past.
Pew. You are all somewhere else, a node away.

events.name: The Sun and Moon Altars: The Altars
events.intro:
The altars. Lillie plays the flute. Nebby glows, and closes up hard as a star (Cosmoem), and opens again, enormous.

Lillie: "It grew up. It grew up and I wasn't ready."

success.text: Lillie holds it, crying, laughing. She gives you both flutes.

effects.text: Nebby grew up at the altars, and went with Lillie.

branches.text: It chose you, back when it teleported into your arms. Lillie lets it. Lunala, wings full of night, comes with you.

success.text: It chose you, back when it teleported into your arms. Lillie lets it. Solgaleo, blazing, comes with you.

events.name: The Light That Would Not Return
events.intro:
The day is dimmer than yesterday. Every day, a little dimmer.

An astronomer: "The sun hasn't changed. The light is being taken before it gets here."
A beam falls from the clear sky and burns a line across the road.
Astronomer: "That was light. It's being thrown away. Something up there is in pain."

success.text: You climb toward where the beams come from.
The light keeps dimming.

events.name: The Light That Would Not Return: The Summit

remembers.notice: The people of Ultra Megalopolis are watching from a rift above the summit.
Necrozma knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Necrozma.

success.text: Necrozma folds its prisms in, and the light comes back all at once. It offers itself.

events.intro: At the summit, Necrozma, black and splintered, swallowing the light.

success.text: A very hard battle.
Six turns: you throw light at it, fire and flash, while it attacks. At the end it becomes Ultra Necrozma for one moment, and gives the light back.
Solgaleo steps forward and lets Necrozma take its light. The region's light returns. Necrozma comes with you, carrying both.
Lunala steps forward and lets Necrozma take its light. The region's light returns. Necrozma comes with you, carrying both.

events.name: The Light That Would Not Return: Light
events.intro: The day is bright again. The astronomer is laughing on the road below.

branches.text: At the foot of the mountain, the people of Ultra Megalopolis give you a small purple Pokémon in thanks: Poipole.

success.text: The light is back.

events.name: The Sword and the Shield
events.intro:
In a ruin, a rusted sword and a rusted shield lie side by side. When you pick one up, the other hums.

Sordward, bursting out from behind a pillar: "Unhand the relics! They belong to our ancestors!"
Shielbert: "Probably."
Sordward: "DEFINITELY."

success.text: You take the sword. Sordward splutters.
You take the shield. Shielbert sighs.
You take both. They are heavy. Both brothers splutter.

events.name: The Sword and the Shield: The Darkest Day 1
events.intro: The sky reddens at night. A Power Spot erupts by the road. The relic in your bag hums louder.

success.text: It hums.

events.name: The Sword and the Shield: The Darkest Day 2
events.intro: Another red night. The relic hums so loud your Pokémon can hear it.

success.text: It hums.

events.name: The Sword and the Shield: The Slumbering Weald

remembers.notice: Zacian knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Zacian.

success.text: Zacian sets its jaw on the sword and looks at you. It comes.

remembers.notice: Zamazenta knows you. It does not want a battle.

addChoices.label: Hold out your hand to Zamazenta.

success.text: Zamazenta sets its jaw on the shield and looks at you. It comes.

events.intro:
Mist. A statue of two heroes. The relics glow.
Two wolves walk out of the mist. They look at the relic in your hand.

Shielbert, quietly, for once: "They came back."

success.text: Zacian steps forward.
Zamazenta steps forward.
Both step forward, and both stand with you, against the first form of the thing that made the darkest day.

events.name: The Sword and the Shield: One Wolf
events.intro: The darkest day is over. Both wolves look at you. One may come.

success.text: Zacian comes. Zamazenta howls once and returns to sleep.
Zamazenta comes. Zacian howls once and returns to sleep.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards

remembers.notice: You read the old tablets. You know why they are angry: each was made from something used to condemn a person who was innocent.

success.text: You kneel at the shrine and say it out loud, for everyone who never did. The stakes go back in by themselves. The curse lifts. No one has to fight.

effects.text: You apologised at the shrine of the Ruinous ones. The curse lifted.

remembers.notice: Your blessing's stake is already out. Its keeper asks you, quietly, not to put it back.

events.intro:
Four purple stakes around a sealed shrine. Two are pulled out and lying in the grass.

A shrine keeper: "Someone is pulling them. Every one that comes out, the whole region gets a little weaker."
Shrine keeper: "People say the Ruinous ones are evil. They're not. They're just angry for a reason no one remembers."

success.text: The freed ones' anger comes at you as you work.
Two stakes out. The region feels it. You go looking.
You pull the last two. The ground shudders. All four are loose now, and the region is cursed.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards: Clue 1
events.intro: A gold coin in the grass by a pulled stake, stamped with a circle.

success.text: One more piece.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards: Clue 2
events.intro: A trader in a gilt collar, asking a farmer whether his neighbour has "enemies".

success.text: One more piece.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards: Clue 3
events.intro: An order book left on a bench: "One stake, region-wide. Delivery by night."

success.text: It leads to a man in a gilt collar, selling the curse as a weapon.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards: The Seller
events.intro: Gilt Circle man: "A curse is just a product. Somebody wants their rival weaker, I sell it to them. Region-wide, even. Very popular."

success.text: His guards step in.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards: Wo-Chien
events.intro: Wo-Chien, free of its stake, in the open. It is angry for a reason nobody remembers.

success.text: Its anger fills the field.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards: Chien-Pao
events.intro: Chien-Pao, free of its stake, in the open. It is angry for a reason nobody remembers.

success.text: Its anger fills the field.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards: Ting-Lu
events.intro: Ting-Lu, free of its stake, in the open. It is angry for a reason nobody remembers.

success.text: Its anger fills the field.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards: Chi-Yu
events.intro: Chi-Yu, free of its stake, in the open. It is angry for a reason nobody remembers.

success.text: Its anger fills the field.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Four Sealed Wards: The Old Tablets
events.intro: Behind the shrine, under ivy, a row of old tablets nobody reads any more.

success.text: Four names, four accusations, four people who were innocent. The things used to condemn them were made into the stakes.
You leave it be and walk on.
